description: Requests a free Cnamio account for an email address, in two requests. With the email alone it sends nothing: it returns confirmation_required, the address, the Terms (https://cnamio.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://cnamio.com/privacy) links and a confirmationToken valid 10 minutes for that address only, so the person can confirm the address and accept before anything is emailed. With the same email, consent: true and that confirmationToken, Cnamio emails a link to the address; only opening it, and accepting the Terms again on the screen it opens, creates the account (a test application on the simulated sandbox provider and a live application on the free plan). An address that already has an account gets a sign-in link instead, and the answer is the same in both cases. Limited to 3 requests a minute and 10 a day per caller, and a few emails per address. Returns received: true and the next steps; the application secret is never returned (it is generated in the dashboard). The answer also carries a 30-minute sandbox session (sandbox).

confirmationToken.description: Second request only: the confirmation_token the first request returned for this email.

consent.description: Second request only. true: that person confirmed this address and accepted the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

email.description: The email address of the person the account is for.

locale.description: Language of the email and the dashboard.

name: start_signup
title: Start a free Cnamio account
